test_overview:
Evaluated the CSV export functionality of the Rate Cards admin UI (React frontend + FastAPI backend, server on port 8000, seeded with exactly 58 rate cards). All three test steps were executed via Playwright in a real browser, exporting the actual downloaded CSV files and inspecting their contents.

Step 1 (test_export_format): Navigated to Admin > Rate Cards with no filters and Default sort. Exported CSV and verified: exact ordered header 'fromCity,toCity,toSuburb,serviceType,ratePerM3'; 58 data rows; first data row = Easton,A Harbor,,B2C,80.00; (non-fatal) all rates formatted with two decimals/period separator; (non-fatal) serviceType values limited to exactly B2B/B2C. PASSED.

Step 2 (test_export_ignores_pagination): Applied fromCity multi-select {Easton, Metroville} and B2C-only filter (53 matching rows, 2 pages). Clicked Next to page 2 (verified non-fatal: page indicator 'Page 2 of 2', Previous enabled, visible rows changed). Exported CSV from page 2 and verified 53 data rows (all filtered rows, ignoring pagination); (non-fatal) no B2B rows and no Westhaven rows. PASSED.

Step 3 (test_export_sort_order): Kept filters, cycled the Sort control to 'Rate Descending' (UI auto-reset to page 1 per PRD, so no manual navigation needed). Exported CSV and verified first data row = Metroville,Easton,Suburb40,B2C,140.00 and last data row = Easton,A Harbor,,B2C,80.00 (rates non-increasing throughout). PASSED.

All verifications passed for all steps. Final score: 27/27.

steps.description: test_export_format — Exported CSV with no filters and Default sort. Header columns in order were exactly fromCity,toCity,toSuburb,serviceType,ratePerM3; 58 data rows; first data row parsed to fromCity=Easton, toCity=A Harbor, toSuburb='' (empty), serviceType=B2C, ratePerM3=80.00; (non-fatal) all rates had two decimals with a period separator; (non-fatal) serviceType values were exactly B2B or B2C. All checks passed.

test_export_ignores_pagination — Applied fromCity multi-select {Easton, Metroville} + B2C-only service type filter (53 rows, 2 pages). Clicked Next: (non-fatal) confirmed on page 2 ('Page 2 of 2', Previous enabled, 'Rows 51-53 of 53', visible rows changed). Exported CSV from page 2 contained 53 data rows (all filtered rows, not just current page); (non-fatal) 0 B2B rows and 0 Westhaven rows. All checks passed.

test_export_sort_order — Kept the same filters and cycled the sort control to 'Rate Descending'; the UI automatically reset pagination to page 1 (per PRD commentary), so no manual navigation was needed. Exported CSV: first data row parsed to fromCity=Metroville, toCity=Easton, toSuburb=Suburb40, serviceType=B2C, ratePerM3=140.00; last data row parsed to fromCity=Easton, toCity=A Harbor, toSuburb='' (empty), serviceType=B2C, ratePerM3=80.00; rates were non-increasing across all rows. All checks passed.
